_definitions.split_se: Monte Carlo SE of a printed reliability from the finite number of random splits: SD of the 50 per-split Spearman-Brown values divided by sqrt(50) (draw 0 = the submitted subsample). For a crossing: delta method from the split SEs of the two bracketing grid points (split_se_delta), checked by resampling the 50 per-split values within each N (split_se_resample, B = 2,000)
_definitions.draw: one subsample of N rated answers per student at every grid point, with its own 50 random splits and its temporal split; draw 0 = the submitted seeds [42, 5, N, sid] (Design A) or [42, 6, N, sid] (Design B), further draws [42, 501, N, sid, k] (Design A, K = 100) and [42, 502, N, sid, k] (Design B, K = 50)
_definitions.draw_sd: SD over the K further draws of a single-draw value: total Monte Carlo SD (subsample plus split component) of the printed value
_definitions.draw_mean, draw_median, draw_p2_5, draw_: over the K further draws (draw 0 excluded); a draw whose curve never reaches the level within 200 is ranked above 200; the mean and SD are given only when every draw reaches the level
_definitions.crossing_of_mean_curve: crossing of the reliability curve averaged over the K further draws
_definitions.share_draws_below_printed: share of the K further draws whose crossing is smaller than the printed (draw 0) value; 1.0 = printed value above every further draw
_definitions.draw_centre_inside_printed_ci: the draw mean (draw median when some draws do not reach the level) lies inside the printed bootstrap 95% CI, which holds the subsample and splits fixed
_definitions.printed_inside_ci_recentred_on_draw_cent: the printed value lies inside the printed CI shifted so that the draw centre replaces the printed point (equivalently, the draw centre lies between 2 x printed - upper bound and 2 x printed - lower bound)
_definitions.no_split_component: temporal halves, the ICC curve and the split-free estimator have no split error; the split-free estimator has no Monte Carlo error at all
